scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.test: npm test --prefix server && node scripts/test_phase1.mjs && node scripts/test_vite_proxy.mjs && node scripts/test_phase2.mjs
